name: AlgoRover
tagline: Research and backtest trading strategies through AI conversations
description: AlgoRover is an AI agent for quantitative trading research and historical backtesting. Users can discover published strategies, configure backtests using public market data, and review research reports through AI conversations. Research offers cloud and local editions and requires an AlgoRover login, without exchange credentials or order execution. AlgoRover Live supports exchange demo testing and user-approved execution on a computer or user-provided VPS. External AI workspace and hosting costs may apply. Historical results do not predict future returns.
